name: InternationalTransfer
description: Aggregate root for the international wire transfer lifecycle. Created by SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003) in PH-029 when PER-002 (Corporate Client) submits an international transfer instruction. Tracks the transfer from initiation through compliance screening, FX execution, SWIFT pacs.008 message assembly, nostro/correspondent processing, and final settlement confirmation via SWIFT gpi. The gpi_uetr is the globally unique SWIFT gpi end-to-end reference visible in the gpi tracker and surfaced to PER-002 in the corporate portal. Introduced by JRN-009.
owning_capability: CAP-003 (Payment Operations — International Payments, promoted sub-capability CAP-003.04)

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-010 at PH-029. Internal identifier. Immutable.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (ENT-B001). Immutable. PER-002 must be an authorised user on the linked BusinessAccount.

fields.name: business_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessAccount.business_account_id (ENT-B002). Originating debit account. Immutable.

fields.name: beneficiary_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–140 characters. SWIFT ISO 20022 structured creditor name. Beneficiary legal name. Required for FATF travel rule (UK FTR 2017) originator/beneficiary information obligation.

fields.name: beneficiary_iban
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 13616 IBAN. 15–34 characters. Validated against ISO 7064 MOD-97-10 check digit algorithm.

fields.name: beneficiary_bic
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 characters). Validated against SWIFT BIC directory at PH-029. Must be a live BIC.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. Currency-denominated. Must be > 0. Immutable after compliance clearance.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. Validated against bank's supported currency list. Immutable.

fields.name: fx_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required for cross-currency transfers. 6 decimal places. Set to 1.000000 for GBP transfers. Immutable after FXQuotation acceptance.

fields.name: gbp_equivalent
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. amount / fx_rate. Used for BusinessAccount debit and FATF travel rule GBP equivalent disclosure. Immutable after FXQuotation acceptance.

fields.name: purpose_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code (4-character code). Validated against SWIFT CBPR+ approved purpose code list. Included in pacs.008.

fields.name: charges_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: OUR | SHA | BEN. Maps to ISO 20022 ChargeBearerCode. Sourced from PER-002 selection.

fields.name: swift_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set at PH-032. SWIFT EndToEndId (max 35 characters, ISO 20022 compliant). Immutable after assignment.

fields.name: gpi_uetr
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set at PH-032. RFC 4122 UUID v4. SWIFT gpi Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference. Globally unique per SWIFT gpi rules. Surfaced to PER-002 in portal tracker. Immutable after assignment.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_compliance | fx_pending | compliance_cleared | message_assembled | in_transit | processing_at_correspondent | credit_confirmed | completed | sanctions_blocked | fraud_blocked | failed | cancelled. State machine transitions enforced by SVC-010.

fields.name: initiated_by_user_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessAccount.authorised_users[].user_id. Records the initiating portal user. Immutable.

fields.name: second_authoriser_user_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when amount > BusinessAccount.payment_approval_threshold. Immutable after set.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every status transition.

relationships.description: InternationalTransfer may have multiple FXQuotation records (lapsed + one accepted). Only one FXQuotation may have status = accepted at any time.
InternationalTransfer has one CorrespondentRouting record, created at PH-032.
InternationalTransfer has one SWIFTMessage record, created at PH-032.
InternationalTransfer belongs to one BusinessCustomer via business_customer_id FK.
InternationalTransfer is debited from one BusinessAccount via business_account_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: InternationalTransfer is a wholly new entity owned by SVC-010 (CAP-003). It does not extend ENT-008 (PaymentIntent) or ENT-009 (PaymentExecution).
design_decisions.rationale: International transfers have a materially different lifecycle (FX quotation, SWIFT assembly, correspondent routing, gpi tracking) from FPS payments. Cross-entity reuse would violate the service ownership principle and couple unrelated lifecycles.

design_decisions.decision: beneficiary_iban and beneficiary_bic are stored directly on InternationalTransfer rather than referencing a separate Beneficiary entity.
design_decisions.rationale: A Beneficiary entity is appropriate for a beneficiary management journey (address book). JRN-009 captures beneficiary details per-transfer. A future Beneficiary management journey should introduce the Beneficiary entity at that time.
